threads.body: This class-wide assumption also aborts `absentSelectorKeepsJfrDisabled` and `emptySelectorKeepsJfrDisabled`. Those two paths intentionally build without a JFR selector, so `RuntimeTelemetryBuilder` never starts JFR and they remain valid—especially on a runtime without JFR, where they verify that the library can stay disabled cleanly. Please scope the availability assumption to `starPatternSelectsAll` and `exclusionsWinOverShorthandAndLegacySelections` instead of skipping all four tests.
